newsitem.title: EU: Official Journal contents - OJ L 151 of June 11, 1997.
newsitem.headline: Official Journal contents - OJ L 151 of June 11, 1997.

text.p: (Note - contents are displayed in reverse order to that in the printed Journal)
COMMISSION DECISION of 9 June 1997 terminating the anti-dumping proceeding concerning imports of certain briefcases and schoolbags originating in the People's Republic of China

COMMISSION DECISION of 20 May 1997 amending for the sixth time Decision 95/32/EC approving the Austrian programme for the implementation of Article 138 of the Act concerning the conditions of accession of the Republic of Austria, the Republic of Finland and the Kingdom of Sweden (Only the German text is authentic)

COMMISSION DECISION of 20 May 1997 authorizing Member States to provide for derogations from certain provisions of Council Directive 77/93/EEC in respect of plants of strawberry (Fragaria L.), intended for planting, other than seeds, originating in Argentina
COMMISSION DECISION of 20 May 1997 amending the list of declining industrial areas covered by Objective No 2 as defined by Council Regulation (EEC) No 2052/88

COUNCIL DECISION of 2 June 1997 authorizing the automatic renewal or continuation in force of provisions governing matters covered by the common commercial policy contained in the friendship, trade and navigation treaties and trade agreements concluded between Member States and third countries
COMMISSION REGULATION (EC) No 1040/97 of 9 June 1997 establishing the standard import values for determining the entry price of certain fruit and vegetables
COMMISSION REGULATION (EC) No 1039/97 of 9 June 1997 deferring the final date for sowing certain arable crops in certain regions in the 1997/98 marketing year
COMMISSION REGULATION (EC) No 1038/97 of 9 June 1997 on the supply of cereals as food aid
COMMISSION REGULATION (EC) No 1037/97 of 9 June 1997 on the supply of vegetable oil as food aid
COUNCIL REGULATION (EC) No 1036/97 of 2 June 1997 introducing safeguard measures in respect of imports of rice originating in the overseas countries and territories (OCTs)
COUNCIL REGULATION (EC) No 1035/97 of 2 June 1997 establishing a European Monitoring Centre on Racism and Xenophobia

Information relating to the entry into force of the Interim Agreement on trade and trade-related matters between the European Community, the European Coal and Steel Community and the European Atomic Energy Community, of the one part, and the Republic of Slovenia, of the other part END OF DOCUMENT.
